title: Inventory Report (v1)
description: Validates internal/model.Inventory exactly as produced by internal/inventory.Scan (privacy="private") and internal/inventory.Sanitize (privacy="sanitized"), and written/read via internal/report (gamelib inventory scan / report summary). A private report is for local-only use (never synced/shared) and may include per-file observations with root-relative paths; a sanitized report strips observations entirely and clears relativePath from any remaining issues, so it is safe to attach to bug reports.

toolVersion.description: gamelib build/version string that produced this report.

privacy.description: "private" reports contain root-relative paths (never absolute filesystem paths) and may include the full observations[] array. "sanitized" reports (internal/inventory.Sanitize) contain no observations and no relative paths at all — issues[].relativePath is cleared, not merely emptied, so the key is absent.

roots.description: One summary per configured root that was scanned, present in both private and sanitized reports.

observations.description: Optional (model.Inventory.Observations, json:"observations,omitempty"). Present only in private reports produced directly by inventory scan; absent from sanitized reports.

issues.description: Optional validation issues surfaced during scan (model.Inventory.Issues, json:"issues,omitempty").

RootSummary.description: model.RootSummary. Only id/kind/fileCount/totalBytes/mediaCount/imageCount are always present; system and the three map fields are omitted when empty.

extensions.description: Optional histogram of bare extension -> file count.

roles.description: Optional histogram of inferred role -> file count.

DuplicateSummary.description: model.DuplicateSummary. All five counters are always present (no omitempty in Go), and are 0 rather than absent when there is nothing to report.

groups.description: Number of distinct SHA-256 values with more than one occurrence.

copies.description: Total redundant file occurrences across all duplicate groups (occurrences - 1 per group, summed).

excessBytes.description: Bytes that could be reclaimed by de-duplicating all groups.

crossRootGroups.description: Duplicate groups whose occurrences span more than one root.

uniqueFileHashes.description: Total distinct SHA-256 values observed across all scanned files.

ValidationIssue.description: model.ValidationIssue. rootId/relativePath are omitted (not merely empty) when not applicable to the issue; code/message are always present.

relativePath.description: Root-relative path the issue pertains to. Always absent in sanitized reports.
